label: Product and customer discovery
description: Problem, customer or user discovery that shapes what is built.

label: Roadmap ownership
description: Owns or sets a roadmap or product strategy for a product area.

label: Prioritisation and backlog
description: Owns backlog, release or feature prioritisation.

label: Outcome ownership
description: Accountable for product outcomes such as adoption, conversion, retention or revenue.

label: Requirements analysis
description: Elicits requirements, process maps or specifications.

label: Delivery and execution
description: Plans and coordinates delivery, launches and dependencies.

label: Data analysis
description: Analyses data, funnels, experiments or metrics; builds dashboards or models.

label: Technical engineering
description: Designs, builds or integrates software, APIs or models.

label: Design and user research
description: Interaction design, usability testing and design research.

label: Customer and account management
description: Manages customer accounts, escalations and renewals or resolves customer issues.

label: People leadership
description: Leads or mentors people or teams.

label: Strategy and portfolio
description: Sets multi-product, portfolio or organisation-level strategy.
